question: Which of the following schools of Philosophy provides details on why it is important to conduct Vedic rituals for a person to attain moksha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Purva Mimansa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Sankhya, Yoga, Nyaya, Vaisheshik, Purva Mimansa, and Uttar Mimansa (Vedanta) are the 6 classical schools of Indian philosophy.
 
• They accepted the theory of karma and rebirth, and the ideal of moksha is conceived as liberation from the cycle of births and deaths.
